Part 2&3 事件 EVENTS

Describe a live sports event you watched and liked

描述一个你看过并喜欢的现场体育赛事

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

Part 2 话题卡片

Describe a live sports event you watched and liked

  • What it was (是什么赛事)
  • When and where you watched it (你什么时候在哪里看的)
  • Who you watched it with (你和谁一起看的)
  • And explain why you liked it (并解释你为什么喜欢它)

问题与答案

Cue CardDescribe a live sports event you watched and liked

I'd like to talk about a live esports event I watched and really enjoyed, which was the final of a big League of Legends tournament. It took place last year, and I watched it at home, alone, on my computer. The event itself was the world championship final, where two top teams from different regions were competing for the title. I'd been following the tournament for weeks, so I was really excited about the final match. I watched it live on a streaming platform, with the chat going crazy in the background, which made it feel almost like being in a stadium. I watched it by myself, which might sound a bit lonely, but honestly it was perfect for me. I could focus completely on the game, pause to grab a snack, and cheer as loudly as I wanted without bothering anyone. The match went to five games, and the last one was incredibly tense, with both teams trading leads until the very end. The reason I liked it so much is that I've played the game myself for years, so I could appreciate the skill and the strategy behind every move. Watching professional players do things I could never pull off was genuinely thrilling. All in all, it was one of the most exciting evenings I've had, and I still remember the final team fight clearly.

我讲的是去年在家独自看的一场英雄联盟世界赛总决赛。我追了好几周，特别期待决赛，在直播平台看，弹幕刷得飞快，像在体育馆里一样。一个人看其实正合我意：能完全专注、随时暂停拿零食、想怎么喊就怎么喊。比赛打满五局，最后一局双方交替领先，紧张到极点。我之所以这么喜欢，是因为我自己玩这个游戏好几年，能看懂每一步背后的技巧和策略，看职业选手打出我永远做不到的操作真的很过瘾。那是我最兴奋的夜晚之一，最后那波团战我现在还记得。

Q2Why do some people like to watch sports events?

I think there are several reasons. First, watching sports is exciting, because the result is unpredictable and the tension keeps people engaged. Second, many people watch because they play the sport themselves, and they can appreciate the skill and learn from it. There's also a social side, because watching a match with friends or discussing it online creates a sense of belonging. So I'd say it's a mix of entertainment, interest and community.

原因有好几个。首先看比赛很刺激，结果不可预测，紧张感让人投入；其次很多人自己也玩这项运动，能欣赏技巧、从中学习；还有社交因素，和朋友一起看或网上讨论会产生归属感。所以是娱乐、兴趣和社群感的结合。

Q3Where do people normally watch sports events?

These days, most people watch sports at home, either on television or on streaming platforms, because it's convenient and cheap. Some people also watch in public places like sports bars or cafes, especially when there's a big match, because the atmosphere is more exciting. Of course, fans who can afford it go to the stadium to watch live, which offers the most intense experience. So I'd say the choice depends on budget and how much people care about the atmosphere.

现在多数人在家看，电视或流媒体平台，方便又便宜。也有人去体育酒吧、咖啡馆这类公共场所看，尤其大赛时气氛更带劲。当然，预算够的球迷会去现场，体验最强烈。所以选哪里取决于预算和对气氛的在意程度。

Q4What are the advantages of watching sports events online?

I think the biggest advantage is convenience, because people can watch from anywhere, on their phone or computer, without buying a ticket. Online platforms also offer more choice, since you can watch matches from other countries that aren't shown on local TV. Another benefit is flexibility, because you can pause, rewind, or watch highlights if you miss part of the game. Having said that, the main downside is that the atmosphere at home can't compare to being there in person.

最大优势是方便，不用买票，手机电脑上随时能看。线上平台选择也多，能看本地电视不播的国外比赛。还有灵活性，可以暂停、回放，错过部分还能看集锦。不过缺点是家里的气氛没法跟现场比。

Q5What sports matches are suitable for children to attend?

I'd say matches that are relaxed and family-friendly are the most suitable. For example, school sports days and local amateur games are perfect, because the atmosphere is friendly and there's no risk of crowd trouble. Professional matches can also be fine, especially sports like swimming or athletics, where the crowd is generally calm. Having said that, I think parents should avoid very intense matches, like big football derbies, where the crowd can get aggressive and the noise might scare young children.

轻松、适合家庭的比赛最合适。比如学校运动会和本地业余比赛就很好，气氛友好、没有人群风险。职业比赛也可以，尤其游泳、田径这类观众比较平静的项目。但家长应避免太激烈的比赛，比如大型足球德比，人群可能激动，噪音也会吓到小孩。

Q6待补充

Yes, I think it can be, for many people. Watching a match takes your mind off daily stress, because you focus completely on the game, and the excitement can be a great release. For example, after a long week of work, many people look forward to watching their favourite team play. Having said that, it doesn't work for everyone, because some people get too nervous or angry when their team loses, which is the opposite of relaxing. So it depends on the person.

对很多人来说是的。看比赛能把注意力从日常压力上移开，完全投入比赛，兴奋感本身就是一种释放。比如辛苦一周后，很多人就盼着看主队比赛。但对有些人不行，球队输了他们会紧张、生气，反而更累。所以因人而异。
